name: Data Visualization
description: Choose the right chart for your data and draw it: SVG for the web, PNG for Word and PDF files, or a native chart inside an Excel workbook.
abilities: Picks the chart that fits what the data has to show, or says when a table is better
Draws bar, line, area, stacked, scatter and histogram charts with chart.py
Uses color-blind-safe colors, a title that states the finding and labeled units
Puts charts in Word documents, PDFs and Excel workbooks
permissions: Uses the Code Sandbox: runs in your private, offline sandbox
Uses the Documents and Spreadsheets plugins to put charts in files
